title: Are you lonely in a crowd?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why can someone feel lonely even when surrounded by many people?
Is having a few close relationships more important than having a large social network?
Can workplaces, universities, or cities do anything meaningful to reduce loneliness?
Does online communication reduce loneliness or sometimes hide it?
What is one sign that someone may be lonely even if they appear socially active?
